newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NISSAN EUROPE SALES UP IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: NISSAN EUROPE SALES UP IN JULY.

text.p: Nissan Europe said on Thursday new registrations of its vehicles rose 25.9 percent in July compared with the same month in 1996.
Sales were boosted by the popularity of the new UK-built Primera and Micra models and the Spanish-built Terrano II four wheel drive vehicle, Nissan Europe said.
European sales of the Primera this year -- up to the end of July -- were up more than 56 percent over 1996, while month sales of Micras rose 17 percent and Terranos 39 percent.
Nissan Europe's best markets in July were Italy, with sales up 83.9 percent over the same month last year, Spain, up 54.6 percent and Denmark, up 40.6 percent.
Nissan sales in Europe as a whole had risen 9.8 percent in the year to the end of July, compared to a total industry increase of only 3.1 percent, the company said.

The figures cover Amsterdam-based Nissan Europe's 16 major continental markets -- Germany, Spain, France, Italy, UK, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium/Luxembourg, Austria, Portugal, Greece, Ireland, Denmark, Norway, Sweden and Finland.
